answer_sentences.text: The provided Gold Loan FAQ excerpt does not state any pre-payment charge percentage.
answer_sentences.quote: 2.3 What is the tenure? Gold loans are granted for a period of up to 12 months. The loan may be renewed on maturity after a fresh appraisal of the ornaments.
